name: mega-sdd
description: Marketplace for the mega-sdd plugin — a lane router and result contract for Claude Code, with an opt-in spec pipeline for traceability.

plugins.name: mega-sdd
plugins.description: Lane router for Claude Code (direct / assisted / guarded) with a result contract on every run; one opt-in spec pipeline (plan -> execute-bolts) for traceability; legacy extraction and team documents.

plugins.name: mega-sdd-extras
plugins.description: Optional companion to mega-sdd: /mega-sdd-extras:slice — ONE Figma page/frame per run (your own Figma MCP; image/URL fallback) into framework-conventional UI code, render-checked via the mega-sdd Playwright MCP. Zero hooks/scripts; zero cost when not invoked.
